title: fix(types,components): ui:calendar selection shape follows its mode (objectui#10304)
body:
Fixes #10304
Clause-②: yes. A published type and the mirror accept set change. An isolated at-tier review happens before enqueue.

Direction (i) per objectui#7759 ruling 5617465269 rule 2 (`CalendarSchema` is objectui-own, so the read site is the truth). Serial after objectui#10302, which merged at `8c10f4f7`; this branch is cut from it.

## Measurement before coding (the claim's stop condition)

The claim said: stop and report if `mode: 'multiple' | 'range'` has no in-tree author AND the designer does not offer them. Both halves are false on `8c10f4f7`:

- authors: `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-form-calendar/multiple-dates.json` (`mode: "multiple"`) and `date-range.json` (`mode: "range"`), both referenced by `content/docs/components/form/calendar.mdx`;
- designer: the `ui:calendar` registration `inputs` offers `mode` as an enum containing `multiple` and `range`.

So retirement (iii) is not the candidate, and this PR implements (i).

## What changed

| face | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/form.ts` `CalendarSchema.value` / `.defaultValue` | `Date \| string` | one day, a list of days, or `{ from, to }` (`to` optional); a day is `Date \| string` |
| `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts` `CalendarSchema` / `UiCalendarSchema` | `z.union([z.string(), z.date()])` per key | the same three shapes per key (the range is a strict object, so `start` / `end` is refused), plus a node refinement that refuses a shape its `mode` does not read: `single` (default) takes one day, `multiple` a list, `range` a pair. Issue code `custom`, path the offending key |
| `ui:calendar` renderer (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx`) | one-day read for every mode; strings coerced only when the whole value is a string | per-mode read; every day coerced through `toDisplayDate`. A misfit shape selects nothing instead of throwing, and is NOT reshaped (a lone day is not wrapped into a list: AGENTS.md #0.1) |
| docs `content/docs/components/form/calendar.mdx` | one-day `value` | per-mode table, a JSON example per mode, and the schema block |

Both bugs from the card:

- `multiple` + one day: refused at the mirror (`value` path); if it reaches the renderer anyway, it no longer throws `selected?.some is not a function` and selects nothing.
- `range` + `{ from, to }`: accepted by the mirror and selects every day of the range.

The mirror refinement is on the node, not on the key, so `CalendarSchema` and `UiCalendarSchema` are both built from one unexported key set (`CalendarObjectSchema`) and each applies the refinement. The reason: zod 4 refuses `.extend()` that overwrites a key on an object that already carries a refinement.

### The TS face admits every shape on every mode

The declaration is still a single `interface`, so its `value` / `defaultValue` are the key-level union of all three shapes, and the mode pairing is documented on the key and enforced only by the mirror. A real discriminated union on `mode` would turn `CalendarSchema` from an `interface` into a type alias. Several gates and tests look the declaration up as an `InterfaceDeclaration` by name, for example `check-component-surface-parity`, `check-readme-exports`, `check-designer-field-key-parity` and the parity test's ledger lookups. I did not make that change here. It is raised in the report as an open question.

## Parity ledger

`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` passes unchanged. Both faces moved to the same key-level set, so no `KnownDrift` or `WiderThanDeclared` row appeared or left. No figure re-derived.

## Tests (head `dd123d7f3`)

- New: `packages/types/src/__tests__/calendar-selection-mode-10304.test.ts`. It checks every mode against every shape, on both mirrors and both keys, and asserts `success`, the issue path and `code: custom`.
- New: `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/calendar.selectionModes-10304.test.tsx`. It checks range selecting its days, multiple selecting each listed day, and multiple plus one day not throwing.
- Extended: `calendar.dateValueZone-10293.test.tsx` has three new driven cases west of UTC, for list and range days. The existing driver `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` already runs that file and passes (6/6).
- Updated: `calendar-date-value-boundary-10293.test.ts`. The type pin now expects the three-shape union, and the list refusal now holds in single mode.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: 225 files, 5056 tests passed. `packages/components/`: 292 passed, 1 skipped file; 2821 passed, 17 skipped tests. `examples/schema-catalog/`: 33 files, 2182 tests passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/components` passed after building the closure of `@object-ui/components` and its dependencies. `--listFilesOnly` confirms the three test files are in the test programs.
- `eslint .` in both packages: exit 0.

Ablations. Each was committed first, then mutated, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. Each restore was checked by an empty `git diff HEAD` and a match against the HEAD blob hash.

1. Renderer set back to its `8c10f4f7` bytes: the multiple-plus-one-day case goes red (1 failed, 5 passed). The range cases stay green in the suite zone (UTC), because the picker's own parse already lands on the named day there. That is why ablation 2 exists.
2. Per-day coercion replaced by the engine parse, run in the forked child with the zone moved west of UTC: 3 failed, 10 passed. The failures are the existing single-day case plus the new list and range cases.
3. Mirror refinement disabled: 7 failed, 10 passed across the two type test files. The strict range object still refuses `start` / `end` and a missing `from` without the refinement, as expected.

## Gates

Exit 0: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, and `spec-main-shape-gate --self-test` (26/26).

NOT MEASURED:

- `spec-main-shape-gate inject`: it needs a spec tarball packed from objectstack `main` followed by a repo-wide typecheck. That is the gate's CI job. This diff does not touch any `@objectstack/spec` import.
- `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:readme-exports`: prerequisite not met, because they need a whole-tree build. None of them reads the JSON or plaintext fences edited here. The three JSON examples added to the doc were parsed against `UiCalendarSchema` and all three pass.

## Acceptance notes

- The `ui:calendar` registration `inputs` offers `mode: 'default'`, and the mirror refuses it (`invalid_value` at `mode`). That is a designer-offered value that fails validation. It is not fixed here and was not filed; it is listed in the report for the seat.

Changeset: `.changeset/10304-calendar-selection-modes.md` (minor for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/components`).
